description: Vantage FinOps connector (read-only). Reads cloud and SaaS cost data and active cost-saving recommendations from the Vantage API v2 at `api.vantage.sh`, authenticating with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from VANTAGE_API_TOKEN (create a Read-only Vantage API token). Four tools: `vantage_cost_list` (GET /costs, day-binned, paged), `vantage_recommendation_list` (GET /recommendations, active only), `vantage_cost_get` (GET /cost_reports/{token}) and `vantage_search` (substring search over active recommendations). Optional env: VANTAGE_COST_REPORT_TOKEN, VANTAGE_WORKSPACE_TOKEN and VANTAGE_GROUP_BY. Cost requests are paced at one per 1.2 s and stop at the first 429. No write tool; GET only.
author: Nimbus
